experiments.objective: Validate first-play comprehension, delight, and return intent with representative players.
experiments.hypothesis: At least four of five representative players will complete a meaningful first choice without coaching and name a concrete reason to return.
experiments.metric: Unassisted first-action success and concrete return intent
experiments.target: At least four of five sessions succeed, including two return visits.
experiments.nextExperiment: Test the highest-severity comprehension or delight gap found in round one.
